༄༅/ /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi gegs sel rnam grol rol mtsho'o/ /na mo mañdzu shrī ye/zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'jug gi yan lag ga

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi gegs sel rnam grol rol mtsho'o//

na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi 'jug gi yan lag gegs sel rnam grol rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa nyams myong gi rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gus pas brten na srid zhi yi/ /nyes skyon kun las grol na rnal 'byor gyi/ /bar chad phra mo smos kyang ci 'tshal ba'i// dpal ldan bla mar gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'dir dgegs sel gyi gtso bo ni/ lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa dang khyad par dbang rnam par dag pa thob cing*/ de dus khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa/ yang dgos 'khrid kyi sngon 'gro bsags sbyang la nan tan mchog tu byas te/ sngon 'gro dpyid las dang 'dra bar brdar sha dpyad ces pa ltar byas pa dang*/ zhe dgos bla mar mos gus ma skyes pa skyed pa dang skyes zin gnas pa dang gnas zin gong nas gong du spel ba la skyes bu'i rtsal ci yod kyis 'bad na/ 'gal rkyen thams cad rang zhi dang rten 'brel thams cad rang 'dzoms la 'gro ste/ yon tan che skye chung skye bla ma la brten nas skye| skyon che 'grib chung 'grib thams cad bla ma la brten nas 'grib ces pa 'brom ston pas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gang dag 'di ltar bla ma'i mos gus bsgom pa blun po dang btsun ma'i chos su byas nas bla ma'i phyogs su lus dang longs spyod kyi tshogs dang rgyu gron cung zad kyang mi nus par lam zab mo'i rtogs pa skye ru re nas gnas dben por byas pa gcig tu gcig pur bsdad pas rings por ma thogs par/ sems la gdon dang*/ lus la nad bzhugs pa gcig byas/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs su 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen bor nas/ rlung sbyor phran tshegs dang*/ dbyug bcos 'jib ru sogs kyi man ngag phra mos mgo bskor ba'i zog po re'i drung du gegs sel zhu ru 'gro dgos pa'i mkhas rlom nga rgyal gyi sgang bur gyur pa dngos grub kyi gter sgo g.yas su bzhag nas ngan song gi g.yang sgo g.yon du 'byed pa dag la ni/

gegs sel gyi man ngag brgya phrag bstan kyang khong skran shin tu dam pos zin pa la phy-i nas byugs pa phran tshegs byas pa ltar phan par dka' yang gang dag lam gyi rtsa ba ma 'chugs kyang sngon gyi las sgrib dang 'phral rkyen cung zad la rten/ phugs lam gyi bogs 'don pa'i phy-ir du/ brgya sbyin lha'i dbang pos byams sems kyi spyod pa'i che ba bstan par 'dod nas bskul ma mang du byas pa'i skyes rabs dang tshul mthun pa 'byung srid pa dag la phyi nang rtsa rlung gi sbyor ba la sogs pas gegs sel tshul dang bogs don tshul bla ma dam pa nyams myong can mang po'i man ngag las 'byung ba dang rang gis kyang nyams su myong ba 'ga' zhig gi brjod par bya'o/ /de la gegs kyi rigs bsdu na gnyis/ sems la gnod pa bdud bgegs| lus la gnod pa nad gdon/ lam la gnod pa bying rgod/ de rnams la yang mi 'byung bar bsrung ba dang byung ba 'don pa'o/ /dang po la spyir bsrung ba ni/ yar bla ma dkon mchog la dad gus/ mar drin can sems can la snying rje/ spyir snang grags sgyu mar rtogs pa'i lta ba rnams la 'bad pas gegs thams cad bsdu zhing sel bar nus te/ gegs kyi rtsa ba las dang nyon mongs pa mtha' dag 'joms par nus pa'i phyir ro/ de yang gtso bo las dang po pa la las ngan gyi sgrib pas gnod pa dang por byed pa'i phyir na las sgrib sbyang ba'i phyir du/ bla ma dkon mchog gi phyogs su lus kyi mkhar lan dang spyi las khyad par can drag tu byed pa rje nā ro pa dang mi la'i rnam thar lta bu la bslab par bya'o/ so sor bsrung ba ni/ bdud bgegs la bsrung 'khor thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa bsgoms/ nad la 'byung pa 'khrug pa'i las dal po dang drag shul can dang*/ zas ha cang tsha ba dang bsil ba mang du bsten pa lta bu nad 'jug pa'i spyod lam 'bad pa chen pos 'dzem/ gdon la/ sa cha gnyan sar gdol spyod mi byed/

mi 'dod pa byung pa'i tshe yid mi bde ba'i 'phro mi mthud par chos thog tu bzhag ste yid bde 'ba' zhig rgyun du brten/ bying rgod la bying ba'i rgyu zas ha cang 'grangs pa dang gos ha cang drod pa dang gnas khang 'thibs pa dang grib dang mi gtsang ba la 'dzems dgos pa la zas gos sogs gsum snga ma las zlog pa dang*/ bde sdug la dga' gdung gi tshor ngas chen po spangs shing rnam rtog 'phro gcod pa sogs te/ chu ma byung gong du rags brgyag pa ni byung nas zlog pa las tshegs chung zhing phan yon che bas thog mar bsrung zon la brtson par bya yi/ gegs kyis khyer zin zin gyi bar du bsrung zon gtan mi byed pa dang*/ ngo shes bzhin du phra mo nas mi zlog par u tshugs byed pa ni dud 'gro las kyang blun zhing khyad par nyer 'tshe phra mo la bzod sran chung na chos pa'i nang du mi tshud par 'dzin pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud las phra mo nas bsrung zhing zlog dgos pa dang*/ khyad par rgyud las/ dang por mtha' dag rgyal ba'i lus ni sngags pa rnams kyi dngos grub rgyu ru yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /zhes sogs bsrung dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bsrung tshul phra mo nas rgyas par gsungs pa rnams dang 'gal zhing*/ blun pos bsngags pa'i chos pa don du gnyer ba'i snang shas kyis rgyal bas sngags pa'i chos pa'i dkyil nas don par 'gyur bas spangs par bya'o/ / des na dang por bsrung ba la nan tan du byed pa ni gegs sel gyi gtso bo nyid du bzung shigaganyis pa byung nas 'don pa la brtag pa dang bcos pa'o/ /dang po la bdud bgegs brtag pa ni/ spyir ltas dang mtshan ma ngan pa dang rmi lam rtsub po la sogs pa bdud dang bgegs kyis byas pa'i nges pa med de| bla ma dkon mchog dang*/ dkar phyogs kyi lhas lam la bskul ba'i ched du byas pa mang ste/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das lam la slob pa'i tshe lha'i dbang pos bskul ma byas pa'i rnam thar mang du 'byung ba ltar ro/

/yang rmi lam ltas bzang ba dang*/ phral du bde ba dang re zhig dngos grub myur ba lta bu yang bla ma dkon mchog gi byin rlobs yin par ma nges te/ de lta bu bdud rigs rnams kyis 'bad nas byas pas so/ /des na ltas bzang ngan dang phral du bde mi bde tsam la bar chad dang dngos grub tu byar gtan nas mi rung ste las dang po pa la phal cher zlog pa mang bas so/ /'o na ji ltar brtag ces na/ rjes bzang ngan gis shes te/ de'i rkyen gyis blo las su rung du song ba dang*/ bla ma'i mos gus lta bu'i rtogs pa gsar du skyes pa'am skyes zin bogs thon pa'i thabs su song byung na 'phral du bgegs kyi mtshan mar snang yang bla ma dkon mchog gi byin rlabs su nges la/ de las zlog na dngos grub kyi mtshan mar snang yang bgegs kyi mtshan ma yin par gdon mi za'o/ /gnyis pa nad gdon brtag pa la/ nad kyi gtso bo rlung mkhris bad kan gsum las/ rlung ni/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab re bzhi dang gsang gnas kyi phyi skor bcu drug ste brgyad cu la gnas nas grang ba'i nad gtso bor skyed pas lus kyi smas lji ba dang*/ bshang gci'i lam mi bde zhing de gnyis dgag dka' ba dang*/ sems 'phro zhing gnyid med pa dang*/ zas bsil bas 'phel ba la sogs pa 'byung ngo*| |'khris pa ni mgrin pa'i so gnyis dang snying kha'i brgyad de bzhi bcu la gnas nas tsha ba'i nad gtso bor skyed pas/ sha dkar ba dang rngul mang ba dang sen mo ring zhing skron pa dang*/ khyad par kyug stangs 'byung zhing zas la bro ba mi tshor ba dang gnyis che ba dang mgo bo lji ba dang*/ zas drod bcud can gyis 'phel ba sogs 'byung ngo*/ /bad kan ni/ gtsug tor gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi dang dpral ba'i bcu drug ste nyi shu la gnas nas tsha grang gnyis ka gtso bor bskyed pas| sha mdog nag pa dang*/ snum mdog dang skrag mdangs med pa dang*/ pho ba mi bde ba dang*/ zas zhu rjes tsha long byung zhing chu skyur skyug pa dang*/

lus lci ba dang*| grang gzhi 'phel zhing zas rnying bcud kyis 'phel ba sogs 'byung ngo*/ khyad par nang gi don snod lnga las 'chin pa la nad yod pa'i ltas su mig mi gsal tshag pa sogs 'byung*/ mkhal ma la yod na rna ba 'on pa dang*/ rnag bsog pa sogs dang*/ glog ba la yod na snas dri mi tshor ba dang bsnabs mang*/ snying la yod na lce mi bde zhing 'brum pa sogs 'byung*/ mcher pa la yod na lus kyi reg bya mi tshor ba dang khol bur na ba sogs 'byung*/ de ltar don snod lnga po skyon med pa'i me tog ni mig sogs dbang po gzugs can lnga yin no/ /gzhan yang rus pa la nad yod na so sen dkar zhing skrag med/ sha la nad yod na dreg pa 'chags shing ba spu log chu rgyus la nad yon na so sen skrag med ring po yong*| khrag la yod na chu dmar ba'am ser po 'ong/ ltag sbrubs la nad yod na skra spu gyen du ldog ste de la sogs pa nad kyi ltas brtag par bya'o/ /gdon gyi ltas ni/ steng gdon la lus sbrid/ dran pa rmongs/ rmi ltas mun pa 'thibs pa sogs 'byung*/ 'og don la lus sems lc-i/ dug gsum 'phel/ lus khol bur na tsha dang 'brum bu sogs 'byung*/ rmi ltas sdig sbrul dang sbal pa sogs 'byung la/ snga ma'i grogs rgyal 'gong dang*/ phyi ma'i grogs bdud ma mos byed pas de dag gi rmis ltas la sogs pa 'byung ngo*/ /bying ba'i ltas ni dran 'phro brjed par 'gyur zhing shes pa spros kyang 'phro bar mi 'dod pa'o/ /rgod pa'i ltas ni/ ma dran pa dran/ shes pa bsdus kyang 'dur mi ster ba'o/ /gnyis pa bcos pa la/ bdud bgegs bcos pa ni/ bsrung 'khor thun mong min pa/ 'dus pa phyi ma nas ye shes zhabs lugs las gsungs pa lta bu bsgoms shing*/ g.yon du drag tu 'khor bas bdud bgegs btub cing gcod pa lta bu dang*/ 'dus pa 'phags lugs dang dus 'khor nyid nas gsungs pa lta bu'i phur gdab khyad par can dang bgegs bsreg pa'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin mang du byed pa la sogs pa'o/

/nad bcos pa la spyi dang bye brag du bcos pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ lam 'bras pa'i phrin las so gnyis sogs kyang bsngags mod kyi/ 'dir bi bhū ti dang ko brag pa'i man ngag las byung ba bu ston rin po ches sdom du bsdus pa'i lung sbyong nyi shu pa/ gnad sbyang nyer bzhi/ rlung lnga 'phrul 'khor 'du ba spyi 'joms kyi 'phrul 'khor rnams bya ste/ ji skad du dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo la/ /gus pas rab tu btud byas nas/ /lus sbyong gnad kyi 'phrul 'khor rnams/ /rang dang gzhan la phan phyir bris/ /dang po lag bkru lta bu ste/ /gnyis pa lag zlog brang la bkan/ gsum pa gzhu sra 'gengs pa 'dra| |bzhi pa lag gnyis rdo bcog 'dra/ /lnga pa lag gnyis brang nas bgyed// drug pa lag gnyis dpyang drag brkyang*/ /bdun pa skyil dkrungs ri 'phul 'dra// brgyad pa lag 'ju brla steng bzhag /dgu pa lag snol lus bag gcu// bcu pa lag gnyis rgyab tu brdung*/ /bcu gcig stag ltar bskag pa bsang*/ /bcu gnyis lag gnyis mdun rgyab ston/ /bcu gsum lan gsum sgu ba dang*/ /bcu bzhi lan gsum bgye ba dang*/ /bco lnga thor tho nas bzung 'then/ /bcu drug mdun rgyab 'phra ba dang*/ /bcu bdun g.yas g.yon 'phra ba dang*/ /bco brgyad lag gnyis gting bcug bskor/ /bcu dgu lag gnyis dpus mo gnan/ /nyi shu rkang pa mnyam la dgyed/ /srog bsdu ba ni rab tu gces/ /thams cad la ni lan gsum bya/ /lus sbyaung nyi shu zhes bya'o// gnad kyi sbyang ba nyi shu bzhi/ /dang por rna ba g.yas g.yon mnye/ /gnyis pa mig sgril phyogs bzhir blta/ /gsum pa sna rtse mnye zhing mthen/ /bzhi pa lce brkyang phyogs bzhir drang*/ /lnga pa mgo cog lan gsum bya/ /drug pa spyi gtsug drag tu mnye/ /bdun pa lag sbre ltag pa mnye| |brgyad pa smin mtshams drag tu mnye/ / dgu pa mgo bo g.yas g.yon bcu| |bcu pa phrag pa mnye bsig skyod/ /bcu gcig mchan khung g.yas g.yon mnye|

|bcu gnyis nu ma mnye zhing skyod/ /bcu gsum lto ba skor zhing dkrug/ bcu bzhi kha bsdams drag tu byed/ /bco lnga mgrin pa gcu zhing mnye/ /bcu drug snying kha drag tu sprug /bcu bdun 'dom gnyis rab tu bsgrad/ /bco brgyad bshang lam 'byed 'dzums bya/ /bcu dgu bol gong drag tu mnye/ /nyi shu byin pa rab tu mnye/ /nyer gcig brla gnyis de bzhin mnye/ /nyer gnyis rgya mtsho gnas nas bskyod/ /nyer gsum stag mo'i skyug stangs bya/ /nyer bzhi lus po thams bcad mnye/ /nang gi gnad chen sbyang ba'o/ /rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dag la yang*| |gnad du bsnun pa'i 'phrul 'khor ni/ /mgo bo bskor zhing mgo bo 'then| |mgo bo dkrug zhing mgo bo ljog /mgo bo bskyod dang rnam pa lnga// gyen rgyu gnad du bsnun pa'o/ /ro stod skor dang ro stod gcu/ /sky-il dkrungs ri 'phul dbang po dgang*/ /rgyab tu bkan zhing mdun du bsdud/ /srog 'dzin gnad du bsnun pa'o/ /lto ba bskyod dang 'phar byed dang*/ / sus rten lto 'khrog skran bcor dang/ /gser gling dkyil dang rnam pa lnga/ / mnyam gnas gnad du bsnun pa'o/ /g.yas g.yon thur du sprug pa dang*/ /btun brdungs langs pa'i brkyang brkum dang*/ /nyal ba'i rkyang brkum 'phyong rgyug lnga/ / thur ser gnad du bsnun pa'o/ /rkang pa g.yas g.yon phra ba dang*/ /mdun dang rgyab du phra ba dang*// lag pa dpyang drag brkyang ba dang*/ /lag pa drag tu sprug pa dang*/ /rlung gi zhags pa 'phang dang lnga/ khyab byed gnad du brnun pa'o/ /thams cad mnye zhing stong gsum bskyang*/ /mgo bo mnye zhing mgo bo ljog/lag pa bskor zhing rgyab brdung bya| |lag pa gcu zhing gnad drug bcings/ /rgyab du bkan zhing mdun du bsdu| |rgya mtsho dkrug par byed pa rnams/ /pad+ma'i 'dug steng la gnas bya// 'dis ni 'byung ba gnas su 'jug /'du ba'i nad kun gnad nas 'byin/ /ri bo sgul zhing bya rkang btsugs/

/mthe bong gny-is nas 'then pa ni/ /rdo rje skyil dkrungs la gnas bya/ /lus sbyong gnad kyi 'phrul 'khor 'di/ /dge slaung rin chen grub kyi sbyar/ /yi ge pa ni dus 'khor ba/ /'jam dbyangs dkar po zhes byas bris/ /'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi nad rnams zhi bar gyur cig ces pa lag len phyag 'khrid dang bcas pa ri phug gzim khang du 'jam dkar/ bsom nams grub/ rgyal ba chos grub gsum la gnang*/ phyis rin po che chos kyi dpal/ des 'jam pa'i rdo rje bsod nams 'phel/ des bdag la dgyes bzhin du phyag 'khrid dang bcas te gnang ba gnad sbyong bcu gsum pa dang*/ srog 'dzin sbyong ba ma chags tsam gyis kyang nad phra mo mtha' dag zhi bar nyams su myong ngo*// tshigs bcad de dag kyang phal cher go sla la/ lus sbyong gnyis pa la/ lag pa rdo rje bsdams pa phyir zlog te'o/ /bzhi pa rdo rje bsdams pa bar snang du steg ste dpus mo'i steng du sdebs pa'o/ /brgyad pa khu tshur gnyis brla steng du'o/ /dgu pa gru mo gnyis phan tshun bzung ste'o/ /bcu pa re mos kyis so/ /bcu gcig pa langs nas lag gnyis steg ste'o/ /bcu gnyis pa gcig gi lag thil du gcig gi rgyab cug pa re mos su skyaung ba'o/ / dgye dgu rgyab mdun du'o/ /thor tho ni sor mo'i rtse mo'o/ /phra ba ni rkang pa phra shags byed pa'o/ /gnad sbyong gi nyer gnyis pa rgya mtsho ni lto ba'o/ /rgyab tu bkan zhing mdun du bsdu ba ni/ lag pa so so'i bar lta bu dang lag ngar gang 'byor drag tu sbyar la gru mo gnyis rgyab tu dang mdun du brkyang ba'o/ /skran bcor ni/ lto ba sgal tshig la drag tu sbyar zhing sgal tshig nyid drag tu skyod pa'o/ /gser gling dkyil ba ni thur sel drag tu sdoms pa'o/ /thur sel gyi thur du dkrug pa sogs ni rkang pas so/ /rlung gi zhags pa 'phang pa ni lag pa g.yas khu tshur bcang ste shed dang bcas pas mgo la lan gsum skor nas zhags pa skyur ba lta bu dang g.yon pas kyang de bzhin du byed pa'o|

|lag pa gcu ba ni rgyab sprad sor mo rnams snol/ thad sor brkyang pa'o// gnad drug bcing ba ni/ lag pa gnyis sor mo nang sdams snol te/ spyi bo rtag pa skye rnams su bzhag nas lus gcu ba dang*/ lag pa gnyis snol te dpung mgo gnyis nas dang 'chan khung gnyis nas dang/ gcig gis dpung pa dang gcig gis 'chan khung nas bzung ba gnyis dang*/ rgyab du snol te 'chan khung gnyis po nas bzung te lus gcu ba ste/ mdor na lag pa'i 'phrul 'khor mi 'dra bas lus gcu ba drug go /ri bo sgul pa ni rdo rje skyil dkrungs kyi phyi nas lag pa gnyis sa la btsug ste*/ lji skur ba dang*/ hrag nas btsugs tai de bzhin byed pa ni bya rkyang brtsugs pa'o/ /de ltar na/ rgya gar nas rgyud snga ma 'gas/ /cung zad sbas pas cung zad 'thor/ /bstan bcos mkhas pas legs bsdus pa// 'phrul 'khor brgyad cu rtsa gsum tsam/ /zhes bya'o/ /de dag kyang gtso bo rlung bum pa can bzung ba'i ngang nas lan grangs gsum la sogs pa nus tshad byas pas nad 'thor bu ba mtha' dag sel zhing dgos su 'dis 'di sel mang po mdzad pa rnams la ni nges pa mi snang ngo*/ /bye brag tu bcos pa la nad rlung mkhris bad kan la gnas pa'i rtsa 'khor rnams su bum pa can bsgom zhing*/ 'phel byed kyi zas spyod spangs la ldog phyogs bsten/ 'dus pa'i nad gsang gnas kyi bar skor 'dab ma bcu dang nang skor drug la gnas pas der dmigs pa gtad pa'i bum pa can sgom mo/ /bad kan smug po yang 'dus pa'i nad yin pas kun gyi 'phel byed la 'dzems zhing gsar bcud bsten/ mdor na bram ze mchog sred kyi sbyor ba brgya par gsungs pa/ sha rnying bud med rgan mo dang*// chang gsar zho ni ma chags dang*/ /nam phyed zas dang nyin phyed gnyid/ /'di drug rtag tu srog 'phrog go /sha gsar bud med gzhon nu dang*/ /'bras chan 'o ma tshos pa dang*/ /ljon shing sil grib chu dron khrus/

/'di drug rtag tu stobs bskyed do/ /zhes sogs ltar 'dus pa'i nad can gyi 'du ba spyi gnyen gyi sman dang dpyad bsten no/ /rlung sbyor gyis bcos pa ni/ rlung dang grang ba thur sel gyi skyon yin pas thur sel drag tu brkums nas bde ba skyes skyes kyi bar du bzung ba lan mang por byas shing spyod lam kun tu bkum pa'i ngang dang*/ 'dug pa'i spyod lam/ bshang sgo rting pas bkag ste gnas pa la bslab/ byang sems mi 'dzag pa la 'bad/ ang ga rag dron po gyon pa sogs bya'o/ /tsha ba dang mkhris pa gyen rgyu dang mnyam gnas kyi skyon yin pas steng 'og gi rlung cung zad re bzung zhing phyir la drag tu bud/ rlung 'jug dus bar rlung cung zad ma bzung na thal nas grang bar 'gro/ spyod lam lus po brel ba la bslab cing*/ snying kha dang mgrin pa'i bum pa can bya'o/ /bad kan srog rlung gi skyon yin pas/ steng rlung drag tu rngubs nas lte 'og tu bsnan pa la 'bad/ dpral ba'i bum pa can sgom/ 'dus pa khyab byed kyi skyon yin pas nad gsum ka'i rlung sbyor re mos su bya'o/ khyad par rtsa rlung thig le'i bgegs gsum las/ rtsa'i bgegs la 'phrul 'khor| rlung gi gegs la rlung sbyor/ thig le'i gegs la de gnyis ka yod pas dbab bzung*/ zlog 'gram dang khyad par thur sel gyi rlung sbyor la nan tan bya ste| rtsa'i 'phrul 'khor ni bshad zin la/ phyi nas lums dang dugs dang byugs pa sogs kyang bya ste/ sman spyad las 'byung ba bzhin nam/ ma sgrub na'ang zo rnying mar rnying dang ti mar lo mar lo mang lon pa sogs kyis so/ / rlung la/ spyir 'dod sar zin na nad med cing ting nge 'dzin skye yang*/ mi 'dod pa'i sar zin pa dang rengs pa las skyon skyed pas bcos pa'i thabs la/ /rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i dang*| yan lag rlung lnga'i dang*/ spyi'i bcos thabs so/ /dang po ni/ srog rlung snying khar zin na stod 'tshangs dang snying gzer 'ong*/

rengs na snying rlung du 'gro bas| lus chur bcug ste rba la na sa gtad/ sku mnye bya/ rdo rje nor bur sems bzung*| srog 'dzin gnad du bsnun pa'i 'phrul 'khor la 'bad do/ /gyen rgyu zin na pho ba lci/ mkhal rked na gzer skyugs 'byung*/ rengs na pho ga zer dang rmu chur 'gro bas/ chang gi kha phru gdab/ na sar dugs bya/ skyigs bu gdon// de'i 'phrul 'khor bya'o/ shes pa mgrin par gtod/ thur sel zin na spyi mig na| ro rmad bshal/ dri chen ha cang skam slar 'gyur/ rengs na smad 'khyal du 'gro bas/ gshang gci'i lam gyi bar drag tu mnye/ de'i rlung sbyor la 'bad/ rlung bshang bug nas drangs te tshang bug tu 'don/ shes pa tshang bug tu gtad/ gyen rgyu zin na mgrin pa skrangs/ rtse mgo na/ rengs na lkog 'bras su 'gro bas/ rlung thur du gnan zhing de'i rlung sbyor dang mgrin pa'i 'phrul 'khor la 'bad/ khyab byed zin na mgo bo sogs lus khol bur na/ rengs na rgur por 'gro bas/ 'phyong rgyug dang sku mnye bya/ de la bsnun pa'i 'phrul 'khor bya'o/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ni dbang po'i sgo lnga nas rgyu bas/ de lnga na zhing rengs na de lnga nyams par 'gyur bas/ mig gi skam tsha la tho rangs so dreg srin mdzub kyi rtsai la blangs te byugs pa dang chu grang gdab cing gur gum la sogs pa'i bsil sman gdab/ rlon chog la rkang mthil dang lag mthil la byugs pa bya'o/ /rna ba la/ mi na ba'i ngos bkag ste na ba g.yon rlung drag tu gdon no/ sna la yang rlung drag tu rngub cing drag tu dbyung ngo*/ /lce la yang rlung kha nas de bzhin no/ /lpags pa sogs kyi nad la yang rlung drag tu rngub rkang pa'i sor mo bsdus la bro 'phrab/ lag pa'i sor mo brkums la drag tu sprug mtha' dag la gang na sar sems dang bum pa can bzung zhing gtong ba na rlung ro nad dang lhan cig gnas/ de dang de nas 'thon par yang yang bsam mo/

/gzhan yang gsum pa spyi'i log non thor bu ba ni| tsha ba che na/ spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi ga bur gyi chu lta bu babs nas lus thams cad dang khyad par na sa de gang nas med par bsam/ grang na lte ba'i ho las me gyen du 'bar bas de bzhin du bsam/ lus lci na gsang gnas su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis 'degs par dang*/ 'gags na bshang lam dang 'khyims na tshangs bug phye la rlung 'gro bar bsam/ gzer na de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gyis mnan par bsam/ yang na log non lnga ste/ 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba/ gru gu ltar 'dril ba/ bu ga mang po'i dang*/ 'khor lo med pa dang*| rab tu dma' ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ stod 'tshangs lta bu lus dgang nas na na/ bum pa can bzung lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa g.yas dang g.yon du res kyis 'khor bas nad bcad par bsam zhing lto ba dngos kyang de ltar bskor ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying kha lta bu'i lus dmigs kyi na na/ dang por rlung bzung*| gtong ba na gang na sa der bu ga phra mo gcig seng kyis byung ba na phar rlung ro nag po rta rnga tsam zhig 'thon pa phyi rol du gru gu ltar 'dril nas nang du zlog mi nus par bsam zhing rlung ji sbom du btang nas kyang de ltar bya'o/

/ gsum pa ni/ rims tshad lta bus lus khyab par na na/ lus lcags tshags kyi mig lta bu bsam pa nas rlung ro thams cad 'thon par bsam zhing rlung ro phyir la bus ste gdon no/ / bzhi pa ni/ lud stod smad phyed mar na na/ gang na sa de stong sang du bsam zhing rlung ro gdon no/ / lnga pa ni/ shes pa yer zhing 'phyong rgyug byed pa sogs byung na/ nyal sa yang dma' sar bya/ sems kyis kyang rang sdod sa dong gting ring ltar bur bsam pa'i nang du lus thim par yang yang bsam ste 'di dag gis mi sel mi srid pas nus pa gal che'o/ /thig le'i gegs la/ spyir nad gzhis 'dzag pa/ gdon gyis 'dzag pa/ rgyas te 'dzag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dus nges med chu dang gdongs nas 'dzag ste grang nad sel thabs byas pas sel/ gnyis pa ni/ rmi lam du dang lan grangs mang du 'dzag pas lus kyi mdangs stobs 'phrog ste/ nyal khar/ khro bo bsgoms pa dang drag sngags bzlas pa dang bsrung bkud gdags pa sogs kyis sel/ gsum pa ni/ skabs su rdo rje'i lus su rgyud nas 'dzag pa ste/ bskyed rim pa'i hūm̐ phaṭa bu khar bsgom pa dang*/ bum pa can mang du bya ba dang*/ dbab zlog gi sbyor bas sel lo/ /bying pa'i gegs ni/ gnas mtho sar sdad/ shes pa gzengs bstod/ mal gso phri/ zas bsil ba bsten/ khyad par gnad sbyong bcu gsum pa mang du byas pas nges par sel/ rgod pa'i gegs ni| gnas sogs zlog bum pa can bzung nas lus 'phar ste gdan la drag tu 'bebs pa mang du bya/ khyad par snod bcud rten dang brten pa dang sems dpa' gsum brtsaig sogs bsdud rim khyad par can mang du bya zhing*/ snying kha'i nā da la sems 'dzin gtso bor byas pas sel bar gdon mi za'o/ /de ltar skyon dang gegs sel ba ni shin tu gal che ste/ yur ba med par chu drangs na chu zhing khar sleb thabs med pa bzhin du rtsa ma bcos par lam bsgoms kyang ting nge 'dzin brtan mi skye/

yur ba yod kyang sa rdo dang sban sbun ma bsal ba chu drangs na'ang/ phyir 'bo ba ltar rtsa nang gi nad ma bsal bar lam bsgoms kyang gegs che bogs chung*/ yur ba la skyon med par chu zhing gnyar sleb kyang skyes bus zhing la 'grems mkhan med na phyogs gcig nas bo ste mi phan pa ltar/ rtsa la skyon med kyang rlung gi kha lo ma byas par lam bsgoms na phyogs rer gol bar 'gyur bas rlung gis sbyang zhing spel ba la 'bad pa gal che/ zhing thog tu chu thad kar khrems kyang skam rlon gang dgos kyi tshad ma snyoms par sa bon btab kyang mi skye bas/ bying rgod cha ma snyoms na lam gyi nyams rtogs kyi myu gu thad kar mi thon pas bying rgod kyi skyon bsal te bsgoms zhing*/ de la ni/ lo legs dang ni gdam ngag rnams/ /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang*/ /'du mi byed dang 'du byed de// de dag nyes pa lngar 'chad do/ /zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nyes pa lnga sel ba dang*| |gnas dang de la gnas pa dang*/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /dmigs pa rjed par ma gyur dang*/ /bying dang rgod pa rtog pa dang*/ /de spong mngon par 'du byed dang*/ /zhi tshe rnal du 'jug pa'o/ /zhes pa ni/ dad pa brtson 'grus dang*| 'dun pa dang shin sbyangs dang*/ dran pa dang shes bzhin dang*/ sems pa dang btang snyoms te 'du byed brgyad rten tshul legs par shes nas bya ste/ nyes pa lnga spongs 'du byed brgyad/ /brten pa'i rgyu las 'byung ba'o/ /zhes rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bsgoms pa'i skabs su rgya cher gsungs zhing gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin gyi tshogs le sogs nas 'byung ba ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pa yan lag rnams la bslabs te dgegs med cing*/ bogs thon par bslabs par bya'o/ / gang la 'bad na lam gyi mi mthun phyogs/ phyi dang nang gis bsdus pa ma lus kun/ /legs par sel byed lam gyi yan lag 'di/ /spyi dang khyad par lam la rnal 'byor du/

/byed 'dod skal ldan gdul bya'i ched du byas/ /dge bas rang gzhan mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub mchog gis rtag tu rol gyur cig /ces zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi 'jug gi yan lag gegs sel rnam grol rol mtsho zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ gsung rab spyi dang khyad par gyi lung dang rtogs pas lang 'tsho yol bar byas pa'i dge slong lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos thams cad 'dul zhes bya ba me mo phag gi rgyal gyi zla ba'i nya la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ /'dis kyang spyi dgos rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgya cher 'byung bar gyur cig/ // maṃ gaṅga laṃ// bha wan+tu shu bhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/zab lam rdo rje rnam 'byor gyi gegs sel rnam grol rol mtsho/ -PAGE 454--PAGE 453-- PAGE 449-
